mapper.sql: c.*, s.adapter_type AS source_type, s.connection_category, s.vendor_hint, s.name AS source_display_name, s.version AS source_version, d.device_type, d.manufacturer, d.model, e.host AS address_host, e.port AS address_port

LEFT JOIN camera_source_endpoint e ON e.id=( SELECT ep.id FROM camera_source_endpoint ep WHERE ep.source_id=s.id AND ((s.connection_category='PLATFORM' AND ep.purpose='PLATFORM_HTTP') OR (s.connection_category='RTSP' AND ep.purpose='RTSP') OR (s.connection_category='DEVICE' AND ep.purpose IN ('DEVICE_HTTP','VENDOR_HTTP','ONVIF','RTSP'))) ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.connection_category='PLATFORM' AND ep.purpose='PLATFORM_HTTP' THEN 0 WHEN s.connection_category='RTSP' AND ep.purpose='RTSP' THEN 0 WHEN s.connection_category='DEVICE' AND ep.purpose='DEVICE_HTTP' THEN 0 WHEN s.adapter_type='ONVIF' AND ep.purpose='ONVIF' THEN 1 WHEN ep.purpose='VENDOR_HTTP' THEN 2 WHEN ep.purpose='ONVIF' THEN 3 WHEN ep.purpose='RTSP' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, ep.id LIMIT 1)
camera_channel c JOIN camera_source s ON s.id=c.source_id LEFT JOIN camera_device d ON d.id=c.device_id AND d.source_id=c.source_id
CASE WHEN c.device_id IS NULL THEN CONCAT('c',c.id) ELSE CONCAT('d',c.device_id) END

CASE WHEN c.device_id IS NULL THEN c.name ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(d.local_name,''),CASE WHEN s.connection_category='DEVICE' THEN s.name ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(d.source_name,''),CONCAT('设备 ',d.id)) END) END

OR LOWER(d.source_name) LIKE CONCAT('%',LOWER(#{filter.name}),'%') ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(d.local_name) LIKE CONCAT('%',LOWER(#{filter.name}),'%') ESCAPE '!')

SELECT AS group_key, AS name, CASE WHEN c.device_id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS identified, d.manufacturer,d.model,s.name AS source_display_name, s.adapter_type AS source_type,s.connection_category, e.host AS address_host,e.port AS address_port, COUNT(*) AS channel_count, MIN(c.group_id) AS group_id, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(c.group_id,0)) AS group_count, SUM(CASE WHEN c.lifecycle='ENABLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS enabled_count, SUM(CASE WHEN c.lifecycle='DISABLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS disabled_count, SUM(CASE WHEN c.lifecycle='PENDING_ASSIGNMENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_count FROM WHERE
GROUP BY ,, CASE WHEN c.device_id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END, d.manufacturer,d.model,s.name,s.adapter_type,s.connection_category,e.host,e.port ORDER BY MAX(c.created_at) DESC,MAX(c.id) DESC

SELECT FROM WHERE AND =#{groupKey}
ORDER BY c.id ASC
SELECT c.* FROM camera_channel c JOIN camera_source s ON s.id=c.source_id WHERE () AND c.lifecycle='ENABLED' AND c.id IN #{id} ORDER BY c.id

SELECT c.*,s.connection_category,e.host AS address_host,e.port AS address_port, CASE WHEN c.device_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(d.local_name,''),NULLIF(d.source_name,'')) END AS device_name FROM WHERE ()
AND (LOWER(c.name) LIKE CONCAT('%',LOWER(#{name}),'%') ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(d.local_name) LIKE CONCAT('%',LOWER(#{name}),'%') ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(d.source_name) LIKE CONCAT('%',LOWER(#{name}),'%') ESCAPE '!')
AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM camera_status_snapshot f WHERE f.profile_id=( SELECT p.id FROM camera_stream_profile p WHERE p.channel_id=c.id AND p.enabled=1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.id=c.default_preview_profile_id THEN 0 WHEN p.usage_hint='MAIN' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,p.id LIMIT 1) AND f.layer=CASE WHEN s.adapter_type='HIK_PLATFORM' THEN 'UPSTREAM' ELSE #{layer} END AND f.observation_value=#{observation})
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC,c.id DESC
